# package
# Compiled rows are this lane's positive controls: the library is checked
# under the tested package's own identity, so the tested package's own
# internal sibling is admitted (`use of internal package` is the line a
# library checked under <pkg>.test would carry) and upstream's go test of the
# generated files passes. `xonly` (external tests only) is admitted on the
# identity too; whether the transpile forms its external test package
# without an in-package unit is the product's (bashy transpile --go-library
# derives the tested package's name from the in-package unit today), so its
# terminal is not asserted — only that the identity was never the refusal.
# Interpreted rows are by ID (D1) this sprint; the seam's claims there are
# that every file was handed once under its role (no duplicated file, no
# external test file misfiled into the tested package) and the program
# under the testmain identity with the fact.
